name: Blank frame keeps layer names but isolates artwork
description: A new blank animation frame retains the layer list while its pixels are empty; editing it cannot change the first frame.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the studio workspace
Select the pen tool
Draw a short dark stroke near the upper-left of the canvas center
Open the Layers panel
Add a second layer named Ink
Draw a separate stroke on the Ink layer near the lower-right of the canvas center
Add a blank animation frame from the timeline
Verify the timeline selects frame 2, the Layers panel still lists both layer names, and the canvas has neither stroke
Draw a new stroke on frame 2 in an empty area
Select frame 1 in the timeline
Verify frame 1 still contains its original two strokes and does not contain the new frame-2 stroke

name: Lasso hover and masked Delete leave other pixels untouched
description: Hovering with Lasso does not paint, and deleting an irregular selection removes only enclosed artwork without leaving a preview ghost.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the studio workspace
Select the pen tool
Draw one mark near the left side of the canvas center
Draw a separate mark near the right side of the canvas center
Select the Lasso tool
Move the pointer over the canvas without pressing a mouse button
Verify both marks are unchanged and no lasso stroke is painted on the canvas
Draw a closed lasso around only the left mark
Press Delete
Verify the left mark is gone, the right mark remains, and no selection-colored line remains on the canvas

name: Color Replace changes every exact match on the active layer
description: Clicking one color with Color Replace updates every matching pixel on the active layer while preserving a different color and other layers.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the studio workspace
Select the pen tool
Choose a bright pink primary color
Draw two separated pink marks on the base layer
Choose a dark purple primary color
Draw a third mark between the pink marks
Add a new layer
Choose the same bright pink primary color
Draw a fourth mark on the new layer away from the other marks
Select the base layer
Choose a contrasting green primary color
Select Color Replace with tolerance set to zero
Click one of the pink marks on the base layer
Verify both base-layer pink marks became green while the dark purple mark and the new-layer pink mark kept their colors
Undo the replacement once
Verify both original pink marks return on the base layer without changing the other marks

name: Forty-five-degree rotation preserves outlined sprite regions
description: Rotating a centered two-color outlined shape by 45 degrees keeps the dark contour outside the light fill and does not introduce gaps or unrelated colors.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the studio workspace
Select the ellipse tool
Choose a light purple drawing color
Enable filled shapes
Draw a compact filled circle at the canvas center with a wide empty margin around it
Choose a dark purple drawing color
Disable filled shapes
Draw a matching circular outline around the light fill
Open the PixiTools inspector
Expand Pixel Cleanup and RotSprite
Rotate the active layer by 45 degrees with Rotate Cleanly
Verify the resulting shape remains one closed circle with dark pixels on its contour, light purple across its interior, and a transparent margin outside it
Verify the canvas contains no dark blotches inside the fill or isolated light pixels beyond the contour

name: Rotation clipping is rejected without changing artwork
description: A 45-degree turn that would send edge artwork outside the canvas reports the limit and leaves both edge marks unchanged.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the studio workspace
Select the pen tool
Draw a short stroke touching the top-left canvas corner
Draw a separate short stroke touching the bottom-right canvas corner
Open the PixiTools inspector
Expand Pixel Cleanup and RotSprite
Rotate the active layer by 45 degrees with Rotate Cleanly
Verify the studio explains that this rotation would clip the artwork
Verify both corner strokes remain in their original positions and colors
